commit.message:
Scope the graph to what is picked in Flows

On a big change the graph drew every node at once and became
unreadable. It now shows only what the reviewer picked in Flows: a
step, an edge's two ends, or a whole flow through its title, plus the
tests of every node it shows, since flows hold none. Each node with
hidden neighbours shows +N to add them, and a node it opened shows −
to remove what it added and what those nodes opened. With nothing
picked the graph shows a prompt to go to Flows; a review without
flows keeps the whole graph.

Selecting inside the graph only changes the inspector, so Flows keeps
its pick and marks it. The pick is named in a toolbar chip, goes into
the link as focus=, and a finding's Show node or Show edge scopes the
graph to its target. A node selected outside the scope is added to the
graph, and the Tests switch starts on when the review has flows.
